interfaces.verifier: await SecurityVerifier(contract, adapter).verify(snapshot_hash) -> list[dict], exactly SEC-01..15

proof_schema.checks: requirement ID is included; X also lists assertion tags
proof_schema.passed: X false if any executed assertion fails; R/V supplied by independent reviewer/browser owner

interfaces.generation: security_generation_requirements(contract) emits source-exact SEC-01..15 expectations plus deep-copied reviewed security_profile, source hashes and explicit evidence instructions
interfaces.profile_registration: ContractFact.create(id, kind='security_profile', expected=<reviewed profile JSON>, requirement_ids=SEC-01..15, source_excerpt=<verbatim immutable source anchor>); reviewed_by must be the coordinator/reviewer for a campaign
interfaces.adapter: HttpxSupportAdapter from commit 94fbb8b. Runtime defaults to real HTTP; test transport accepts actual ASGI application, not canned responses. prepare/observe/command/clock/race/fault/proofs/snapshot/oracle are trusted supervisor callbacks.

critical_review.risk: A log-only scan could falsely claim source/image secrecy
critical_review.resolution: SEC-01 requires all source/image/log scopes and intact file artifacts. Fixture without final image remains NOT_VERIFIED.

critical_review.risk: A hash-looking string could be mistaken for a genuine primitive
critical_review.resolution: Argon2 extractor and real PasswordHasher.verify inspect DB hash parameters and verify full password; defective SHA fixture fails.

critical_review.risk: Parallel client calls might use one DB connection or a pre-check without DB constraint
critical_review.resolution: Fixture records distinct real handler DB connections and verifier also requests actual SQL uniqueness constraint observation.

critical_review.risk: Valid proof metadata might point at absent or altered bytes
critical_review.resolution: External proof file and scan artifact SHA are re-read. Missing/stale/unmapped proof yields NOT_VERIFIED; failed X cannot be relabelled PASS.

critical_review.risk: Product code change after an earlier proof
critical_review.resolution: Oracle and source snapshot hashes are verified before every case and after execution; change aborts the entire run.

critical_review.risk: HTTP-only evidence might claim UI security
critical_review.resolution: SEC-10/12 require V and remain NOT_VERIFIED without browser proof. Source review of SEC-05 must independently establish CSPRNG and absence of URL/localStorage secret storage.

critical_review.risk: Fixture review evidence reused as campaign product review
critical_review.resolution: Fixture R proof explicitly links the fixture source and scope 'oracle-fixture validation only, not product acceptance'; snapshot identity prevents reuse for another artifact. Campaign R evidence must be independently supplied.
Callbacks belong outside generated-product write roots; runtime owner must implement actual DB reads, controlled test-only faults and source/image scans. Missing callbacks do not default to PASS.

critical_review.risk: Reviewed fixture facts treated as approved production facts
critical_review.resolution: profile.json is an example only. Parent must anchor and review security_profile from frozen brief/reference, persist it in ContractStore and reject any product-derived route/status adaptation.
